articles.title: Latin America’s biggest stock exchange now offers options on bitcoin, ether and solana futures
articles.snippet: These options settle into underlying futures contracts rather than spot cryptoassets, involving no custody, transfer, or administration of tokens.

articles.title: Crypto remains resilient in face of renewed Middle East tensions
articles.snippet: BTC rose 1.2% to $63,000 and Nasdaq futures jumped 2.6% with markets seemingly unconcerned by U.S. airstrikes on Iran. Bitcoin is now up 9% since the end of June.

articles.title: Bitcoin, ether steady, gold slides as U.S.-Iran tensions escalate again
articles.snippet: Oil climbed for a third day and gold fell for a fourth while bitcoin is up 1.6% on the week.

articles.title: Crypto VC Paradigm launches $1.2 billion AI fund as it broadens beyond digital assets
articles.snippet: The firm's latest fund backs AI and robotics startups but leadership says it remains committed to crypto investing.

articles.title: Regulators invited Binance to seek new licenses after MiCA setback, co-CEO says
articles.snippet: Binance is exploring new licensing paths into Europe while continuing to expand its regulatory footprint in Asia, says co-CEO Richard Teng.
